Package io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.wire

Record Class Qos

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.wire.Qos
public record Qos(Priority priority, CongestionControl congestionControl, boolean express) extends Record
Zenoh QoS descriptor: Priority + CongestionControl + an Express flag. Serialised as a single byte carried in a Z64 network extension at extension id 0x01 on PUSH, FRAME, and similar messages.

Wire byte layout (from commons/zenoh-protocol/src/network/mod.rs QoSType):

  7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0
 +-+-+-+-+-+-+-+-+
 |0|r|F|E|D|prio |
 +-+-+-+-+-+-+---+
  • bits 0..2 (P_MASK 0b00000111): Priority (0..7).
  • bit 3 (D_FLAG 0b00001000): don't drop - CongestionControl.BLOCK.
  • bit 4 (E_FLAG 0b00010000): Express (don't batch).
  • bit 5 (F_FLAG 0b00100000): don't-drop-first (unstable BlockFirst in Rust; not exposed here).
  • bit 6: reserved.
  • bit 7: reserved.

NOTE: the QoS byte does NOT carry a reliability bit. Reliability is a per-subscription concern signalled on the transport Frame R flag and on DeclareSubscriber; do not conflate the two.

DEFAULT is (Priority.DATA, CongestionControl.DROP, express=false), matching the Rust QoSType::DEFAULT. When a caller passes DEFAULT, publishers SHOULD omit the QoS extension entirely so the wire output is byte-identical to the pre-QoS behaviour of this client.
